body:
Real founder follow-up (Apple #20015) to the scripted_sequence breakdown. gpose_look_at: per-joint nlerp-clamped look-at, built on newly-exposed gpose_compute_joint_world. gsync.c/.h: named arrival barrier, one-shot ignition signal for simultaneous animation start. Phoneme lip-sync correctly deferred: no WAV/audio-asset loader exists anywhere in SHANKPIT. 10 new tests, full suite green. Commit 8e8ca0c + 8e81ea0.

⚓ ☃
title: Bone-controller look-at (gpose_look_at) + multi-actor frame sync (gsync)
